# Deadline

> > Breaking news and analysis covering Hollywood, streaming platforms, and entertainment industry business.

Deadline is a leading entertainment industry trade publication providing exclusive reporting on film, television, streaming deals, talent signings, and media business developments. The site covers major studios like Warner Bros, Paramount, and Netflix, along with key industry figures including David Ellison, Bradley Cooper, and emerging talent.

## Key Topics

- Netflix streaming deals
- Warner Bros Discovery merger
- Paramount Pictures
- David Ellison
- Bradley Cooper
- Streaming platform acquisitions
- First-look deals
- Documentary filmmaking
- Saturday Night Live
- Apple TV+ originals
- AMC series development
- Lifetime movies
- Climate activism films
- Entertainment industry business
- Theatrical releases
